Mermaid: erDiagram
content.diagram_html:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 600">
    <defs>
        <script type="application/mermaid+json">{
            "code": "erDiagram
    Users {
        INT id PK "Primary Key"
        VARCHAR email
        VARCHAR name
        DATETIME created_at
    }
    Orders {
        INT id PK "Primary Key"
        INT user_id FK "Foreign Key"
        DECIMAL total_amount
        VARCHAR status
        DATETIME created_at
    }
    Products {
        INT id PK "Primary Key"
        VARCHAR name
        TEXT description
        DECIMAL price
        INT stock_quantity
    }
    OrderItems {
        INT id PK "Primary Key"
        INT order_id FK "Foreign Key"
        INT product_id FK "Foreign Key"
        INT quantity
        DECIMAL unit_price
    }
    Reviews {
        INT id PK "Primary Key"
        INT user_id FK "Foreign Key"
        INT product_id FK "Foreign Key"
        INT rating
        TEXT comment
    }
    Categories {
        INT id PK "Primary Key"
        VARCHAR name
        INT parent_id FK "Foreign Key (Self-Referencing)"
    }

    Users ||--o{ Orders : "places"
    Orders ||--o{ OrderItems : "contains"
    Products ||--o{ OrderItems : "is_part_of"
    Users ||--o{ Reviews : "writes"
    Products ||--o{ Reviews : "has"
    Categories ||--o{ Categories : "has_children"
    Products }o--o{ Categories : "belongs_to"}",
            "theme": "default",
            "themeVariables": {
                "primaryColor": "#8B5CF6",
                "background": "#FFFFFF"
            }
        }</script>
    </defs>
    <rect width="800" height="600" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="400" y="300" text-anchor="middle" fill="#1F2937">
        [Mermaid Diagram - Client Render]
    </text>
</svg>
